titles.native: プリティーリズム・オールスターセレクション

description: A selection of the best episodes from the first three series of the Pretty Rhythm franchise: Aurora Dream, Dear My Future and Rainbow Live. In addition, the 5th grader Laala Manaka, a new and upcoming idol, will be making her debut very soon. The main protagonists Aira, Mia, and Naru teach Laala what being an idol is all about.
